probes.question: Does the v3 device-lookup API return JSON for a bare DI without a key?
probes.note: Documented at /resources/developers/v3/device_lookup_api. The old guessed search path /api/v3/devices/search.json returns 404 — lookup requires di, udi or record_key; there is no description search.

probes.question: Is the GUDID release-file download page public and does it list ZIP releases?
probes.note: Release archives gudid_full_release_YYYYMMDD.zip / monthly / weekly are keyless; the monthly update is 7,002,352 bytes (measured with an HTTP Range request before downloading).

probes.question: Does the device 510(k) endpoint answer keyless on api.fda.gov?
probes.note: api.fda.gov (not a separate host) serves the device endpoints. No X-RateLimit-* headers are returned; published keyless limits are recorded in registry/sources/openfda_device_510k.json.

probes.question: Does the PMA endpoint answer keyless and expose pma_number + decision_date?
probes.note: PMA records carry decision_date, applicant, product_code, supplement_number.

probes.question: Does registrationlisting answer keyless with the dotted firm_name path?
probes.note: The field path matters: bare owner_operator.firm_name returns NOT_FOUND. Record also carries reg_expiry_date_year (the listing expiry year).

probes.question: Does the classification endpoint answer keyless with product_code/class?
probes.note: Provides product_code -> device_class + regulation_number, the join key between 510(k) records and the CFR regulation.

probes.question: Is the openFDA bulk-download catalogue public, and does it list device exports?
probes.note: Catalogue only. The device.udi export is hundreds of MB per partition, outside this workstream's byte budget, so no bulk file was downloaded.

probes.question: Does the documented /api/medical-devices/company/ base answer keyless JSON?
probes.note: The OLD path /api/medical-device/device/ returns HTTP 404 (verified separately). Current base per https://health-products.canada.ca/api/documentation/mdall-documentation-en.html is /api/medical-devices/.

probes.question: Does the licence search answer with official licence numbers and dates?
probes.note: Licence objects expose first_licence_status_dt (first issued licence) and last_refresh_dt (database refresh stamp) — see the temporal finding in DATASETS/regulatory/canada_mdall/COUNTS.json.

probes.question: Does the device search answer keyless with trade_name + licence number?
probes.note: device/?licence_number=N is documented but returns an unscoped payload >2.5 MB (measured), so devices are collected by name and attributed to a firm through original_licence_no.

probes.question: Is the ANVISA health-product consultation CSV downloadable without a key?
probes.note: Keyless bulk CSV. The server caps a Range response at 256 KiB, so a bounded prefix is taken rather than the whole file.

probes.question: Can the TGA corporate site be reached at all from this host?
probes.error: ReadTimeout: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='www.tga.gov.au', port=443): Read timed out. (read timeout=30.0)
probes.note: EXPECTED FAILURE (documented, not repaired): www.tga.gov.au resets the TCP connection ('RemoteDisconnected'). apps.tga.gov.au answers 200 but only redirects to the blocked corporate site, and data.gov.au holds no ARTG dataset.

probes.question: Is there a keyless machine interface into EUDAMED?
probes.note: EXPECTED FAILURE: HTTP 429 whose JSON body instructs automated users to use the official EUDAMED data API on the EU Health Data Lake developer portal (subscription key + EU login).

probes.question: Does PMDA publish device approvals in a machine-readable form?
probes.note: HTML index only; approvals are published as HTML/PDF listings with no JSON/CSV/API and no bulk export. MANUAL_ONLY.

probes.question: Does the GOV.UK search API expose an MHRA per-device register?
probes.note: The API answers, but it indexes GOV.UK guidance/alerts content. No per-device UK registration register is published as open data. MANUAL_ONLY.

probes.question: Does the NMPA UDI database expose any machine interface?
probes.note: HTML application shell only; no JSON/CSV export and no documented API. www.nmpa.gov.cn answers HTTP 412 to this client.
